title: Formal Proof Brittleness: How Much Fine-tuning Destroys a Compact Mechanistic Proof?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly addresses the durability of formal verification under model updates. If proofs break after minimal fine-tuning, the deployment model of formally verified AI needs fundamental revision. Extremely high-impact finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires understanding and rerunning proof assumption checks from the compact-proof framework. Fine-tuning the small transformer at progressive steps is straightforward. The main barrier is learning the proof framework. Medium compute is sufficient for small transformers.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear experimental protocol: take verified model, fine-tune at 4 progressive levels, check proof assumptions after each. Single deliverable (proof brittleness curve). Achievable in 30 hours if the proof framework is well-documented.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
